name: Understatement
shows: What you are underplaying had better be there.
image: ☶ mountain beneath ☷ earth. A mountain sitting below ground level.
situation: Height in the low position. The figure has real elevation and puts it underneath, which is the only configuration in the set the tradition calls good in every line. What makes it work is that the height is genuine — a low place with nothing in it is just a low place.

becomes.name: Endurance
becomes.shows: This exact exchange has happened before.
becomes.image: ☴ wind beneath ☳ thunder. Wind underneath and thunder above, an arrangement that keeps recurring.
becomes.situation: Duration. The old reading makes this a marriage: two things in fixed relative position, lasting because the position is stable. The counsel is to hold the course and keep moving, so what endures here is a motion that repeats.

name: The Cauldron
shows: This is being transformed, and you are carrying it by the handles.
image: ☴ wind beneath ☲ fire. Wood fed into flame underneath a standing vessel.
situation: The bronze cauldron is a cooking pot and also the emblem of a legitimate house. Raw things go in and something else comes out. The old lines worry at the legs and the handles, because the vessel can be overturned, and what is inside goes with it.

upper.name: The Clinging
upper.quality: light, and what it depends on

becomes.name: Passing Through
becomes.shows: You are a stranger here, and you will be judged fast.
becomes.image: ☶ mountain beneath ☲ fire. Fire on a hillside, burning across it and moving on.
becomes.situation: The traveller. The old text is full of small practical worries — the inn, the servant, the axe, the lost ox — because a stranger's resources are whatever they are carrying. Success here is called small outright, and the counsel is about conduct, since a traveller gets judged fast and on very little.

upper.name: The Clinging
upper.quality: light, and what it depends on

name: Candour
shows: Your next move has no calculation in it, and that is the exposure.
image: ☳ thunder beneath ☰ heaven. Movement underneath the sky, going the sky's own way.
situation: The name means without falsity, and the figure describes action with no calculation folded into it. The old text puts the unlooked-for misfortune here as well — the cow left tied that a passing traveller takes. Acting straight leaves you open to whatever arrives.

becomes.name: Stalemate
becomes.shows: You are seeking one game and wearing the face of the other.
becomes.image: ☷ earth beneath ☰ heaven. Each half is already where it wants to be, so nothing crosses the middle.
becomes.situation: Heaven rises and it is already on top. Earth settles and it is already at the bottom. Both halves are content and the figure has no traffic in it. Obstruction here comes from satisfaction rather than from conflict, which is what makes it durable.

name: Muster
shows: What would organise this is a fact you have not said.
image: ☵ water beneath ☷ earth. One firm line among five yielding ones, holding the whole figure to a shape.
situation: Water stored underground: a resource that is present, invisible, and organised. The single strong line is the discipline that turns a crowd into a force. The old warning is that this works with an experienced hand and a clear cause, and the same gathering under any other conditions is a mob.

becomes.name: Impasse
becomes.shows: The direct route is closed and you have asked nobody.
becomes.image: ☶ mountain beneath ☵ water. A mountain in front of you and deep water on the far side of it.
becomes.situation: The character is a limp. Going forward is hard here, and the old counsel names the southwest as the favourable direction and sends you to find the great person. The instruction repeated through nearly every line is to turn back and come again with others.

name: Sunrise
shows: This is becoming visible faster than you planned.
image: ☷ earth beneath ☲ fire. The sun clearing the horizon, with open ground under it.
situation: Advance, and the light getting higher. The old text gives a prince horses in quantity and three audiences in a single day, so the figure is about recognition arriving quickly. Everything in it is going up.

upper.name: The Clinging
upper.quality: light, and what it depends on

becomes.name: Shock
becomes.shows: It went off, and it will go off again.
becomes.image: ☳ thunder beneath ☳ thunder. One firm line arriving at the bottom, and then arriving again above it.
becomes.situation: The shock comes, and then it comes a second time. The old text keeps a wonderful detail through it: laughing words, ha ha, and the man who keeps the sacrificial wine in the cup. Terror arrives from a hundred miles off, and the one still holding the ladle is the one who inherits.

name: Restraint
shows: A small rule you never revisited is holding all of this.
image: ☰ heaven beneath ☴ wind. One yielding line holding five firm ones, the way weather is held by wind.
situation: A small force restrains a large one here, and the large one is permitting it. The single yielding line's whole strength is position. The tradition reads the restraint as accumulation: force that cannot discharge yet is being stored.

becomes.name: Emergence
becomes.shows: This has stages, and you are trying to skip one.
becomes.image: ☶ mountain beneath ☴ wind. A tree taking hold on a mountainside, advancing at the rate roots allow.
becomes.situation: Gradual progress, by stages that cannot be skipped. The old text tracks wild geese across six landings — the shore, the rock, the plateau, the tree, the summit — and each is a place the bird stands on before the next. Speed here is set by the ground.
